metaTitle: Jaguar Engine Supply & Fit | Jaguar Garage
metaDescription: Professional Jaguar engine supply and fit service. We source the correct replacement engine and fit it to your vehicle. Get a fixed-price quote after inspection.
lede: Professional sourcing and fitting of replacement engines for all Jaguar models, from X-Type to F-Pace.

blocks.html: We manage the complete process of sourcing a replacement engine and fitting it to your Jaguar. This bundled service covers everything from initial compatibility matching to final road testing — so you get a turnkey solution with a single point of contact.

items: **VIN-matched engine sourcing** — we identify the exact engine code, drivetrain, and emissions specification for your vehicle.
**Quality-checked replacement units** — all engines are hot-run tested and balanced before dispatch.
**Full removal and fitting** — including all ancillaries, fluids, and gaskets.
**Dealer-level ECU coding** — using JLR SDD/Pathfinder to synchronise the new engine with your vehicle's electronics.
**Post-fit road testing** — we verify performance and drivability before handover.

paras: **We provide a fixed-price quotation after a full assessment.** Every Jaguar engine supply and fit is quoted individually based on your specific model, engine variant, and condition.
Contact us to arrange an inspection and receive a tailored quote. [*Pricing disclaimer](/pricing-legal-disclaimer)

steps.title: Vehicle Inspection & VIN Decoding
steps.body: We inspect your Jaguar and record the VIN to identify the exact engine code, drivetrain, and emissions specification required.

steps.title: Engine Sourcing & Compatibility Check
steps.body: Using our verified supplier network, we locate a replacement engine that matches your vehicle's original specification — hot-run tested and balanced.

steps.title: Removal of Old Engine
steps.body: We carefully remove the existing engine, detaching all ancillaries, wiring, and exhaust components. On many Jaguars, the front subframe is lowered to gain access.

steps.title: Fitting the Replacement
steps.body: The new engine is lowered into the bay, reconnected, and all mounts, hoses, and wiring are torqued to factory specifications. New fluids and filters are installed.

steps.title: ECU Coding & System Integration
steps.body: Using JLR diagnostic tools, we program the engine control module to match the vehicle's VIN, immobiliser, and transmission parameters — ensuring full compatibility.

steps.title: Road Testing & Handover
steps.body: We road-test the vehicle to verify performance, check for any faults, and update the service record before returning the car to you.

items.q: What does “engine supply and fit” include?
items.a: It includes sourcing a replacement engine (used, reconditioned, or remanufactured) that matches your Jaguar's VIN and engine code, removing the old engine, fitting the new one, replacing all fluids and filters, performing ECU coding, and road-testing the vehicle.

items.q: How long does the process take?
items.a: Typically 5–10 working days depending on engine availability and the complexity of your Jaguar model. We will give you a clear estimate during the initial assessment.

items.q: Can you supply and fit an engine for any Jaguar?
items.a: Yes, we cover all Jaguar models from X-Type to F-Pace, including classic and modern vehicles. We use VIN-based matching to ensure the correct engine for your specific car.

items.q: Do you provide a warranty on the supplied and fitted engine?
items.a: Yes, all work is covered by our standard warranty. Please see our [warranty page](/warranty) for full terms.

For all Jaguars from the mid-2000s onward, ECU coding is essential to synchronise the new engine with the vehicle's immobiliser, transmission, and emissions systems. We use JLR's official diagnostic tools for this.
